sections.shortTitle: Dealerships Cancellation of Agreements And Contracts Order 1979
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

DEALERSHIPS (CANCELLATION OF AGREEMENTS AND CONTRACTS) ORDER, 1979
DEALERSHIPS (CANCELLATION OF
AGREEMENTS AND CONTRACTS) ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd January 1979]
No. F. 17 (2)/79-Pub.-The following President's Order
made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation of the fifth day of
July 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A.
Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that
behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order:-
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-(1) This
Order may be called the Dealerships (Cancellation of Agreements and Contracts)
Order, 1979.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd January 1979]
No. F. 17 (2)/79-Pub.-The following President's Order
made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation of the fifth day of
July 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A.
Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that
behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order:-
2. Power to cancel
contracts, etc.-(1)
Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force
or in any contract, agreement or usage, the Federal Government, or an agency,
organisation or corporation controlled by the Federal Government, or a company
or organi sation controlled by a corporation set up by the Federal Government,
may terminate, without notice, an arrangement, agreement or contract, whether
oral or written, with any dealer, stockist, distributor, licence holder or
depot- holder appointed by the Federal Government or, as the case may be, such
agency, organisation or corporation for the sale or distribution of goods
produced, manufactured or supplied by it or issued by it for sale.
(2) No compensation shall be payable for the
termination of any arrange ment, agreement or contract under clause (1).
